APCTT-C01.quote: The selected Water-Table Fluctuation method uses the RISE pro-gram to estimate recharge from the product of groundwater-level rises and specific yield.
APCTT-C01.note: Principles of the three methods (water-table fluctuation, soil-water balance, DRAINMOD) with citations.

APCTT-C02.quote: In addition to deriving potential groundwater recharge rates from the DRAINMOD model, two other methods of estimating potential groundwater recharge were used: (1) an updated Minnesota Soil-Water-Balance (SWB) potential recharge model, and (2) the RISE Water-Table Fluctuation (WTF) method (Rutledge, 1997).
APCTT-C02.note: How the compared methods are applied to estimate recharge under drained fields (purpose on p15).

APCTT-C03.quote: Potential groundwater recharge rates, using the RISE WTF method, across all piezometers were 1.55 and 1.94 inches per year, respectively, for water years 2017 and 2018.

APCTT-C04.note: Soil-probe calibration with cored samples (p25) is instrument calibration, not a controlled test of the methods.

APCTT-C05.quote: Two statistics were used to evaluate performance of the individual DRAINMOD models against the measured water levels: mean absolute error (MAE, in centimeters) and the Nash-Sutcliffe index of efficiency (NSI) (Nash and Sutcliffe, 1970).
APCTT-C05.note: Methods tested at instrumented field plots against measured water levels; the abstract reports a lack of agreement between methods.

APCTT-C06.quote: However, all methods did show a fundamental difference between piezometers within the drained area and piezometers outside the drained area, including the third undrained moni-toring plot.
APCTT-C06.note: Borderline: the methods were applied at the real fields to produce the intended recharge estimates, but they disagree with each other.

APCTT-C10.note: A t-test (alpha 0.05) on recharge differences is a scientific result, not performance against stated requirements.

APCTT-C11.quote: Fifty-one piezometers were installed in the three different monitoring plots for this study.
APCTT-C11.note: Field instrumentation, plots, periods and method settings (specific yield 10 percent, SWB version 2.0) described.

APCTT-C12.quote: Overall, there was a lack of agreement between the three methods.
APCTT-C12.note: Evidence concerns the compared recharge methods themselves.

notes: Organizer estimate TRL 5 (the methods disagree). With C06 borderline, this labeller's opinion is TRL 6, low confidence; TRL 5 is equally defensible.
